legend: Darwin is currently researching various traits of his n$$$n$$$ finches that are each currently stored in their own sanctuary. He is trying to understand which finches might be evolutionarily related, so he wants to group them together based on common traits. Specifically, Darwin cares about k$$$k$$$ traits of these finches, and has labeled every variant of each trait with a letter between 'a' and 'j'. There is a lot of coordination to be done in moving these finches around so Darwin needs your help processing and keeping track of all the information. Specifically, there are three types of queries he can request of you:
Since he discovered that trait j$$$j$$$ is a key indicator of genetic similarity, combine any groups with finches which share a value of this trait.
Compute how many birds are currently in Finch i$$$i$$$'s sanctuary (including Finch i$$$i$$$ itself)?
Compute how many birds are in the most populated sanctuary?
input: The first line contains three integers n$$$n$$$, k$$$k$$$, and q$$$q$$$. (1≤n,k,q≤105,nk≤106$$$1 \leq n, k, q \leq 10^5, nk \leq 10^6$$$) — the number of birds, the number of traits, and the number of queries, respectively.
The next n$$$n$$$ lines contain a string si$$$s_i$$$ (|si|=k$$$|s_i| = k$$$) — the values of the k$$$k$$$ traits of the bird, respectively. Every trait value is a character between 'a' and 'j'.
The next q$$$q$$$ lines contain a description of the corresponding query. The line begins with an integer t$$$t$$$ (t∈{1,2,3}$$$t \in \{1, 2, 3\}$$$.
If t=1$$$t = 1$$$, then the line contains another integer j$$$j$$$ (1≤j≤k$$$1 \leq j \leq k$$$) — the trait which finches should now also be grouped by.
If t=2$$$t = 2$$$, then the line contains another integer i$$$i$$$ (1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$) — the finch which the second query should be performed on.
If t=3$$$t = 3$$$, then there is nothing else on the line.
It is guaranteed that there is at least one query of type two or three. Note that queries of type 1 may be repeated.
output: Output the answers for the second and third queries in order on their own lines.

legend.ai: Darwin 目前正在研究他的 n$$$n$$$ 只雀鸟的各种特征，这些雀鸟目前分别被安置在各自的保护区中。他想弄清楚哪些雀鸟可能具有进化上的亲缘关系，因此希望根据它们的共同特征将其分组。具体来说，Darwin 关注这些雀鸟的 k$$$k$$$ 种特征，并用 'a' 到 'j' 之间的一个字母标记每种特征的每个变体。移动这些雀鸟需要进行大量协调工作，因此 Darwin 需要你的帮助来处理并记录所有信息。具体来说，他可以向你提出以下三种类型的查询：
由于他发现特征 j$$$j$$$ 是遗传相似性的关键指标，请合并所有具有该特征相同取值的雀鸟所在的组。
计算当前雀鸟 i$$$i$$$ 所在的保护区中有多少只鸟(包括雀鸟 i$$$i$$$ 本身)？
计算鸟类数量最多的保护区中有多少只鸟？

input.ai: 第一行包含三个整数 n$$$n$$$、k$$$k$$$ 和 q$$$q$$$。(1≤n,k,q≤105,nk≤106$$$1 \leq n, k, q \leq 10^5, nk \leq 10^6$$$)——分别表示鸟的数量、特征的数量和查询的数量。
接下来的 n$$$n$$$ 行每行包含一个字符串 si$$$s_i$$$(|si|=k$$$|s_i| = k$$$)——分别表示该鸟的 k$$$k$$$ 个特征的取值。每个特征值都是介于 'a' 和 'j' 之间的一个字符。
接下来的 q$$$q$$$ 行包含对应查询的描述。每行以一个整数 t$$$t$$$ 开头(t∈{1,2,3}$$$t \in \{1, 2, 3\}$$$。
如果 t=1$$$t = 1$$$，则该行还包含另一个整数 j$$$j$$$(1≤j≤k$$$1 \leq j \leq k$$$)——表示雀鸟现在还应按其进行分组的特征。
如果 t=2$$$t = 2$$$，则该行还包含另一个整数 i$$$i$$$(1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$)——表示要对其执行第二个查询的雀鸟。
如果 t=3$$$t = 3$$$，那么该行中没有其他内容。
保证至少存在一个类型为 2 或 3 的查询。注意，类型为 1 的查询可以重复出现。

output.ai: 按顺序将第二次和第三次查询的答案分别输出在单独的行中。
